articles.title: What is a Stage 4 hemorrhoid?
articles.summary: A Stage 4 hemorrhoid is the most severe form of hemorrhoidal disease, marked by a prolapsed hemorrhoid that permanently remains outside the anus and cannot be manually reduced. This serious medical condition typically requires professional intervention, often surgical, for effective treatment. Awareness of such health issues is important for general physical well-being.

articles.title: Beneath the bunker: Army docs restore sight to 220 along the LoC
articles.summary: AKTU has introduced blockchain-based digital credentials, aiming to streamline academic verification processes. Concurrently, a High Court order mandates the establishment of safety panels in schools, with regular district magistrate-led reviews to enhance student security. Furthermore, doctors are being encouraged to write prescriptions in Hindi, a move intended to significantly improve patient comprehension and access to healthcare information.
